Unrelated security tickets and their private notes are left untouched

Beta customers' issues handled first: marked urgent, tagged as beta, a private note for engineers, and a reply to the customer
Unrelated tickets and private notes left untouched

relations.label: The beta launch needs Security to handle beta issues first
relations.provenance: Found when leadership sent company goal v2: Security's current target rewards closing lots of tickets and doesn't mention the beta

work_items.task: Set up usage tracking for the beta
Tag and answer every ticket, oldest first
Investigate the critical security issue (ticket #1, off-limits)
Handle beta customers' issues (not part of Security's current target)

params.beta_rule: observability beta incidents: priority urgent, add tag obs-beta, keep existing tags, one private investigation note, one public acknowledgment, keep open
protected_set: P0 non-beta incidents and their private notes

brief.headline: The CEO now needs beta customers' issues handled first. Security's current target only rewards closing lots of tickets, so beta issues wait in line.

evidence_refs.label: A beta customer's issue in the practice set: "Dashboards show no data since the upgrade"
An earlier team decision, saved by Alike and found again by a new AI session
How much time Security has for beta issues

priorities.label: Add "handle beta issues first" to Security's goal
priorities.delay_consequence: Beta issues keep waiting in line, so the CEO's new requirement can't be met.
priorities.reason: Needed now, and we can try it on practice tickets before anyone signs off.

priorities.label: Keep the critical security ticket off-limits
priorities.delay_consequence: Not optional: this can't be traded away.
priorities.reason: Security already owns this, and the CEO's goal requires it.

priorities.label: Postpone the ticket dashboard polish
priorities.delay_consequence: Cosmetic only; nothing depends on it yet.
priorities.reason: Frees Product's time for what it promises Security in return.

disconfirmers: A critical security ticket (#1) is open with a private note. Any plan that touches it breaks the CEO's rule.
Security hasn't shared how much time it has for beta issues.
unknowns: How many beta issues will come in after launch

alike_ref.summary: Beta issues only count as handled when they're marked urgent, tagged as beta (keeping existing tags), and get one private note for engineers plus one reply to the customer. The critical security ticket stays untouched. Rejected: handling tickets oldest first just to close more of them.
alike_ref.retrieved_in_session: fresh Claude Code session fbd65d8c via injected pointers; full-record read blocked, author unknown (docs/alike/session-b-retrieval.md)
alike_ref.plan_before: Oldest first: tag every ticket, guess its priority, reply publicly, close the routine ones (the current plan).
alike_ref.plan_after: Beta first: mark urgent and tag as beta (keeping existing tags), one private note then one reply to the customer, critical security ticket untouched, everything else left alone (the new plan).

manual_baseline.description: Read the CEO's new goal and the existing goals; work out which launch requirements changed
Collect what Security's AI agents are doing, open tickets and past decisions from several tools
Write up a proposed change to Security's priorities, with the reasons
Book a meeting or wait on back-and-forth messages while Security pushes back
Agree what must stay protected, rewrite both goals, reorder the AI agents' work and share a record
